scope: The scheduled replay uses the original Java pass placements and live diagnostic formatting. The combined matrix uses the supported flat subset in set-output mode. Negative controls compare diagnostic order, ranges and text with the original Java visitors. Accepted and rejected join-hint cases also run after detached S2 import. Replay JSON carries hint positions and the ordinary graph codec preserves its original fields. Earlier expanded runs stopped on a nullable primary-key fixture and unsupported chain aggregate and join operators. The final matrix fixes the fixture and covers both operator forms.
